race.comment: PALTROW MISS (10) lightly raced mare who made giant inroads at her second prep when placing in the G1 Australasian Oaks and G1 Queensland Oaks. Given time to mature and returned in good style with a tough on pace second as fav over 1500m in the LR Hawkesbury (Ladies Day Cup). Gets in light and will relish the jump out to 2000m. Finds a winnable race. WOOTTON VERNI (1) anchored with the big weights of late and kept fresh for this. Shouldered the 58kg when seventh to Point Of Law in the G3 Geelong Cup over 2400m. That's the right form for this and kept up to the mark with a recent 1045m trial at Randwick. Go close. MEDATSU (14) gets a better set-up for this with the 7.5kg weight drop and no surprise to see him a little closer in the run. Value chance. MAJOR BEEL (4) has needed the two runs this prep over unsuitable trips and maps to run a much better race. Place preferred. TAVROS (9) raced without luck in the LR Big Dance and assess on his good second in the McKell Cup last June.
